Ursa, a Tucson restaurant, forages the Sonoran Desert for unique ingredients like cactus and palo verde tree buds. Chef Aaron Lopez and June Chee, both from the desert, opened Ursa in 2025 after a pop-up in 2023. They emphasize sustainable practices, using ingredients like tepary beans and pima club wheat.
